title: Spermatogenic Cells Isolation
author: Layla Simón
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rwid7ce

steps.title: Sacrifice Rabbits
steps.instruction: Sacrifice rabbits by administering a lethal dose of pentobarbital via the pinna marginal veins.

steps.title: Isolate and Treat Seminiferous Tubules
steps.instruction: Surgically obtain testicles and place them on Petri dishes containing PBS. Remove the tunica albuginea using sterile forceps and treat the seminiferous tubules with collagenase.

steps.title: Select Specific Tubules
steps.instruction: Identify and isolate seminiferous tubules in stages VI to VIII (cells under acrosome development) using the trans-illumination method.

substeps.instruction: Select tubules characterized by a dark lumen (full of spermatids and sperm cells)

steps.title: Extract and Fix Spermatogenic Cells
steps.instruction: Place the selected seminiferous tubules on slides with PBS and extrude them using a cover-slip to obtain spermatogenic cells.

substeps.instruction: Fix the cells with paraformaldehyde in PBS
Smear the cells on slides or transfer them to microtubes
